outside_the_range_entirely.why: an .npz, .png, .csv or .parquet has nowhere to carry a _meta block, so neither leg exists for it and this guard reports nothing about it at all

blindness.reference_resolution_note: finished_utc is written to whole seconds, so a run that ended inside the same second as the reference moment cannot be told from one that ended before it; the guard's time discrimination is 1 s and no finer

hash_covers_one_file_of.why: the producer hash covers the producer's own bytes. Every other module in that closure can be edited, move every number, and leave both legs of this guard holding

blindness.what_a_pass_still_permits: a producer that reads a cache and rewrites its own artifact satisfies both legs; this guard proves a run occurred, never that a quantity was recomputed
